title: George Hotz | Programming | can tinygrad whisper? | AMD Rant | Giving up on AMD | Speech to Text
summary: A long George Hotz live-stream from June 2023 in which he works on tinygrad and rants about AMD's drivers, ultimately declaring he is giving up on AMD. It also touches on hardware and compiler topics.
why: Mostly cited as the source of Hotz's AMD driver rant, which some commenters found validating and others found unflattering.

quote.text: Now I know it wasn't just me.
